definitions.gloss: right in the middle of, in the thick of
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes being at the peak or most intense point of an activity or situation. Stronger than {最中|さいちゅう} alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう}だ。
examples.english: We're right in the middle of a meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm busy right now — I'm in the middle of moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{満開|まんかい}→満開：13319_mankai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧しまい、⟦お{花見|はなみ}→お花見：17953_ohanami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It rained right when the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, so we couldn't have a flower-viewing party.

notes:
USAGE:
An emphatic form of ⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧ (in the middle of). The {真|ま}っ prefix intensifies the meaning, stressing that the activity is at its peak or most intense moment. Used in the pattern ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう} (right in the middle of ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう}: right in the middle of work
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう}: right in the middle of a meal
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|ま}っ{最中|さいちゅう}: right in the middle of a game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧: in the middle of (less emphatic)
